items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...there was a boy, Garnet Clark, went there, but he died, I think, in Europe, didn't he? [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, he did. I think he did.

ctx.x: I said, Cliff, why did you call him that? Isn't that what he is, Hap? I said, well if what did you say, the professor. Said, you could put up anything and read it. So he went to Europe, went to Paris. He stayed about two years and came back. I don't know what happened to that guy.
Now, I wonder who you were talking with there. See, that going -- there was a boy, Garnet Clark, went there, but he died, I think, in Europe, didn't he?
Yes, he did. I think he did.
